name: VANNSH SHAH

summary: Third-year Computer Science Engineering student aiming for a career in ML and AI, with hands-on AI/ML internship experience, 16 completed certifications across AWS, Google Cloud, and OpenAI, and a track record of shipping full-stack projects independently and in teams.
